notes: Pantry now keeps itself going. Every item has a level that drifts down at its usual pace, so the page is roughly right even if nobody touches it; a dashed outline marks the hub's guess. Check before shopping asks about only what looks low: Need it puts it on the list, Still have teaches the hub it lasts longer. Checking it off the shopping list fills it back up. Each item's card has a slider and a usually-lasts number. Kitchen screen: the Recipes button is now Cooking, with Recipes, Menu plan and Pantry inside.
